components.css: .ds-btn-tome { position: relative; display: inline-flex; items-center: center; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 36px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(33, 36, 51, 0.6) 0%, rgba(23, 25, 36, 0.9) 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(232, 208, 141, 0.3); color: #E8D08D; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(232, 208, 141, 0.05); } .ds-btn-tome:hover { border-color: #E8D08D; color: #FDE08B; box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(232, 208, 141, 0.25), inset 0 0 20px rgba(232, 208, 141, 0.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-tome-jewel { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E8D08D; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #E8D08D; transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-tome:hover .ds-btn-tome-jewel { transform: scale(1.5); }

narrative.overview:
EPOS is an ancient starlit observatory and marble library where cosmic lore is engraved into digital tablets with gold inlay. The visual world—termed Celestial Marble—fuses the solemnity and architectural permanence of classical antiquity with the infinite depth of deep cosmic space. Every surface, border, and typographical choice is tuned to make authors feel as though they are not merely operating a productivity database, but transcribing sacred canon into the immutable Akashic records.

The system embraces an austere and restrained philosophy for writing surfaces: clean, translucent containers with refined borders that prioritize raw authorial flow, legibility, and distraction-free creation over frivolous or heavy decorative clutter. Contrast is purposeful and sharp: midnight-sky backdrops (#0F111A) allow Chrysos Brilliant Gold (#E8D08D) accents to shine with celestial luminosity, while delicate hairline star-chart dividers provide architectural grounding without visual noise.
keyCharacteristics: Deep celestial midnight canvases (#0F111A) paired with brilliant Chrysos Gold (#E8D08D) illumination.
Classical, authoritative titling in all-caps tracked Cinzel balanced by deeply readable Cormorant Garamond literature prose.
Austere, translucent glassmorphic surfaces (tome-border) with subtle 3px inset borders and ambient golden hover glows.
Mythic ceremony in functional micro-details: book spine simulations, bookmark ribbons, rotated diamond seals, and star-chart alignment dividers.

rules.name: The Golden Ratio of Gold Rule
rules.body: Chrysos Gold is a sacred illumination, not wallpaper. It must never exceed 10% of any screen viewport. Its rarity is what gives it authority; overuse renders the application gaudy rather than mythic.

rules.name: The Dual-Phase Realm Rule
rules.body: Themes are cosmological shifts, not simple color inversions. Dark mode is 'Night of Chrysos' (deep void with starlight luster); Light mode is 'Dawn of Strife' (pearlescent Olympian marble with deep navy typography and rich gold leaf).

rules.name: The Inscription Case Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is an epigraphic typeface and must always be rendered in uppercase with generous tracking (tracking-[0.15em] or wider). Never render Cinzel in lowercase or with collapsed letter spacing.

rules.name: The Manuscript Line Rule
rules.body: Story prose and lore summaries set in Cormorant Garamond must maintain generous vertical breathing room (line-height: 1.6 or greater) and an italic posture for introspective summaries and blockquotes.

rules.name: The Inset Glow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces glow from the inside before casting shadows outside. Outer shadows are reserved exclusively for interactive elevation responses (hover) and high-priority modal interruptions.

dos: Do maintain a strict 90/10 ratio between midnight void surfaces and Chrysos Gold accents.
Do set all Cinzel headings in uppercase with generous letter spacing (tracking-[0.15em] to tracking-[0.3em]).
Do use italic Cormorant Garamond for story excerpts, lore descriptions, and blockquotes to preserve literary elegance.
Do wrap primary interactive cards in .tome-border or double-line gold corner accents.
Do use subtle hairline gradient dividers (.ornate-divider-h) instead of harsh solid 1px horizontal lines.
Do preserve the mythic Indonesian nomenclature (Kitab Semesta, Pahat Lembaran, Segel, Tinta Cerita, Mata Pengetahuan).
donts: Don't use standard sans-serif system fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial) for headings or body prose; the entire brand moat relies on Cinzel and Cormorant Garamond.
Don't use solid bright gold backgrounds for large containers or cards; gold is an ink, wireframe, and aura, never a slab.
Don't apply heavy, blurry black drop shadows; depth is created with luminous inset glows and subtle elevation shifts.
Don't use garish neon colors; category accents must remain grounded in rich historical mineral pigments (lapis, crimson, brass, umber).
Don't introduce noisy medieval paper textures or grungy distressed edges that degrade text clarity.
